text_block_list.text: One day, at a sporting goods store――

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
――Alright, decided!
This one, and that one... and oh, give me that one over there too!

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
A-All of it?!
I appreciate the thought, but will you be all right...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course. They're all wonderful shoes that clearly show the care and passion of their makers.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Right? You watching over there, you're captivated
by these gorgeous shoes too, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Don't 'huh' me! I'm talking to you!
You just wanna take home every single one of these, right?
choice_data_list: Won't those be too big for the dorm shoe lockers……?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so true!
Groove scolded me about that before, too.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Mm... It's hard to let go, but I guess I have no choice.
I'll just pick one.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you.
Which one do you think is best?
choice_data_list: Shoes that feel light and fast.
Shoes that are heavy, but look great for training.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah. If you're going to buy a new pair anyway,
it's much more fun if they let you run faster.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: All right, let's search for them! The lightest pair of shoes in this entire store!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Once we buy it, let's race right away!
Ehehe, that'll make such a wonderful memory♪
choice_data_list: No, racing against an Umamusume is……

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Aww, what a shame.
I really thought it sounded fun...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: —Ah! Found some lightweight-looking shoes!

Afterward, changing into the shoes she'd just bought,
she dashed off in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see... It does look tough to run on,
but maybe that makes for great training?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Look look, those shoes over there.
They're so big and heavy, just walking in them looks like fun!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, because I've never experienced anything like that before.
Doing things for the first time is so fresh and wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
All right, decided!
Excuse me, I'll take that one, please~!
Having changed into her new shoes immediately after buying them, she walked away with a smile, even if it looked a bit awkward.
